p: against the Midianites: As he had commanded in Nu 25:17, declaring also that the injury done against his people is done against him.
Phinehas the son of Eleazar the: For his great zeal that he bare for the Lord, Nu 25:13.
Balaam also the son of Beor: The false prophet who gave counsel how to cause the Israelites to offend their God.
captives: As the women and little children.
women alive: As though he said, you should have spared none.
in the matter of Peor: For worshipping of Peor.
little ones: That is, all the boy children.
purified with the water of separation: The third day and before it is molten.
men of war which went out: Of the prey that falls to the soldiers.
one portion of fifty: The Israelites who had not been at war, of every fiftieth paid one to the Lord: and the soldiers one of every five hundred.
LORD'S tribute of the sheep was: This is the portion that the soldiers gave to the Lord.
the persons were sixteen thousand: Meaning, of the maids, or virgins who had not slept with a man.
half: Of that part which was given to them in dividing the spoil.
children of Israel's half: Which had not been at war.
We have therefore brought an oblation: The captains by the free offering acknowledge the great benefit of God in preserving his people.
himself: And gave no portion to their captains.
memorial for the children of Israel: that the Lord might remember the children of Israel.
